cf_path: same daily temperature path shifted by -1.0 C on every day
estimand: sum_t [E(Y_t | factual temperature history) - E(Y_t | counterfactual temperature history)]

design.temperature_basis: centered natural cubic spline with two columns; factual min/median/max knots; linear continuation outside boundaries
design.lag_basis: three-column natural cubic cardinal basis over physical days 0 through 14; lag components are not physical lag blocks
design.time_spline: centered natural cubic spline with 35 columns over 5 prespecified years (7 df/year)

simulation_dgp.model_compatible: independent Poisson outcomes generated from the observed-data primary fitted marginal means
simulation_dgp.smooth_omitted_interaction: adds the prespecified seasonal temperature-response term to the factual and counterfactual log means; its amplitude is a scenario setting, not an empirical error bound

interpretation: These estimates condition on this daily aggregate panel, the point temperature proxy, the stated spline model, and the fixed -1 C path.
